comparison.methodology: synthetic large tree (200 files, 10% dirty, seed 86, deterministic digest) + quality-only surface matching rules_lint; metrics: cold + warm wall time, Bazel action count via aquery, cache-hit rate, peak memory where cheap; fairness pins recorded; report-not-gate until noise understood
